feastLines.line: 🔥 The fire settles. Mara has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "A dog-shaped silence at the treeline — I put it down today." "No telegraph you can hear. Watch the birds — when they go quiet, the pack is already moving." "The pack circles — nips from the edge, never committing." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Lauren breathes "So it bleeds." the man in his 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm says quietly "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. the person in their 50s has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Two knobs on glass-still water, watching — I put it down today." "It goes perfectly still. Only the eyes move. Then the water explodes — and the world starts spinning." "It has your leg. The roll starts. Do NOT let it reach the water." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Tariq mutters "So it bleeds." the man in his 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm says quietly "Did it look at you? Before?" 🔥 The fire settles. Sanjay has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Mountain Lord — I put it down today." "It crouches low, tail lashing once, twice. The stripes go still. Then it comes." "A paw rises, claws out — casual, almost lazy. It is not lazy." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Tariq mutters "Tell me you didn't go alone." Owen breathes "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Lauren has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Sweeps Week — I put it down today." "The grass stops moving the way wind moves it. Two amber eyes — then the whole striped avalanche." "It circles, unhurried. It has seen this episode before — and it knows how it ends." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Marcus says quietly "So it bleeds." Tariq says quietly "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Declan has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Murkcap — I put it down today." "The gills begin to breathe — a sweet, wrong smell rolls out from under the cap. The air shimmers." "The cap tilts. The stem creaks like a ship's mast. Get out from under it." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Owen breathes "Say that again — slower." Lauren says "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Nikau has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Flashbulb Moth — I put it down today." "It lands. It folds its wings. The light in the clearing changes, like someone adjusting a lamp." "It lets go of the air and simply... drifts. Somewhere else. Hard to predict." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Hassan mutters "So it bleeds." Tariq says "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Nino has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Moderator — I put it down today." "It reviews you. 'Content noted.' A weak ranging chip while it decides." "'REMOVAL NOTICE.' Defiant or compliant — the hammer is coming down." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Sanjay breathes "So it bleeds." Marcus mutters "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Tariq has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Paparazzo — I put it down today." "The flash charges — whine rising. When it fires, you freeze in place." "Every shot refines its model — hit or miss. At 4, the money shot is unavoidable." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Lauren breathes "Did it look at you? Before?" Nino breathes "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

◈ RESONANCE HARMONICS — SYSTEM: "HYPOTHESIS CONFIRMED. Objects with high observer-attention waveforms function as auxiliary capacitors. We call this RESONANCE HARMONICS. We do not know why the waveforms taste like grief. We have stopped asking." — Hold a keepsake. Think about them. The System will do the math. (It is not math. It is love. The System will never know.) Channel keepsakes from your pack.
